title: EXPO-FT: Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Finetuning for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.25477v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The ability to efficiently and reliably learn new tasks has been a foundational challenge in robotics. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong generalization across diverse manipulation tasks, yet pretrained policies consistently fall short of the reliability required for real-world deployment. Reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning offers a promising path to bridge this gap, but existing approaches either train from scratch without fully leveraging pretrained priors, or fine-tune VLAs without achieving the sample efficiency and success rates that practical deployment demands. We present EXPO-FT, a system for stable, sample-efficient RL finetuning of pretrained VLA policies that closes this gap. Our system solves a suite of challenging manipulation tasks, including routing string lights and inserting the plug to light it up, striking a pool ball into a pocket, and inserting a flower into a wine bottle, eac

translated_title: EXPO-FT：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的样本高效强化学习微调
translated_abstract: 摘要：在机器人技术中，高效且可靠地学习新任务一直是一个基础性挑战。视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在多种操作任务中展现出强大的泛化能力，但预训练策略始终无法达到实际部署所需的可靠性。强化学习（RL）微调为弥合这一差距提供了一条有希望的路径，但现有方法要么从头开始训练而未充分利用预训练先验，要么微调VLA而未达到实际部署所需的样本效率和成功率。我们提出了EXPO-FT，一个用于预训练VLA策略的稳定、样本高效RL微调系统，以弥合这一差距。我们的系统解决了一系列具有挑战性的操作任务，包括缠绕灯串并插入插头使其点亮、将台球击入袋中、以及将花朵插入酒瓶，每个任务均实现高效完成。
tldr: EXPO-FT通过稳定且样本高效的强化学习微调，显著提升了预训练VLA模型在复杂操作任务中的可靠性和成功率。
en_tdlr: EXPO-FT enhances the reliability and success rates of pretrained VLA models in complex manipulation tasks through stable, sample-efficient reinforcement learning finetuning.
